---
type: journal
title: a slow warm morning
tags: [calm, coffee, sunlight]
---
woke up early to quiet golden light spilling across the kitchen. made coffee
slowly, no rush anywhere. the warmth of the mug, the soft hush of a calm house,
sunlight moving gently over the table. everything felt unhurried and gentle — a
peaceful, restful start, the kind of slow warm morning that makes the whole day
feel kind.
